detectionRules: Rejection of sequential hex sequences (1a2b3c4d, 2b3c4d5e, etc.)
Rejection of reversed hex sequences (fedcba98, f5e4d3c2, etc.)
Rejection of stepped arithmetic nibble templates (e8b7c6a5d4f3e2d1)
Rejection of low-entropy artificial hex patterns (< 10 unique hex chars)
Rejection of manufactured hash_* prefixes without underlying physical bytes
